name: Russian codes of practice (SP 20, SP 14, SP 63, SP 16, SP 22)
region: Russia and the CIS states that use the SP codes
description: The Russian codes of practice (alpha 9 track C25), a pack that extends BNBC 2020. Limit states: the first group (strength, stability) as SAEngine's strength combinations, the second (serviceability) as its service combinations. Loads: SP 20.13330.2016 (γf by load type: permanent 1.1, live 1.3, snow 1.4, wind 1.4; the basic combinations with ψt 1.0 / 0.9 / 0.7 of the short-term loads; the floor live loads of Table 8.3 with ψA1 and ψn1; the snow S0 = μ Sg of the snow regions I-VIII with μ of the roof slope; the wind wm = w0 k(ze) c of the wind regions Ia-VII with k(ze) of terrain A, B, C and ze by the building's proportions, the pulsation wp = wm ζ(ze) ν; deflection limits of Appendix E). Earthquake: SP 14.13330.2018 (the intensity of 6-9 points MSK-64 of the OSR-2015 maps A, B, C per city, the map by the responsibility; soil categories I-IV with the one-point shift; Sik = K0 K1 S0ik, S0ik = Qk A β(Ti) Kψ ηik with A 0.1, 0.2, 0.4 g, β(T) by the soil category, K0 by the purpose, K1 by the allowed damage of the system, Kψ 1.0; the modal method with the close modes; ηk of a linear first mode for the static method; the special combination with 0.9 / 0.5; the height limits by intensity). Concrete: SP 63.13330.2018 (Rb, Rbt and Eb of B15-B60 with γb1, Rs of A240 / A400 / A500C, the rectangular block with ξR, the nonlinear deformation model's two- and three-linear diagrams as an alternative section method, shear by the inclined section Qb + Qsw, punching, crack width, deflection, cover, anchorage and laps, the least steel). Steel: SP 16.13330.2017 (Ry of C245-C390 by thickness with γm, γc, φ of the curves a, b, c by λ̄, the linear interaction). Foundations: SP 22.13330.2016 (the design resistance R = γc1 γc2 / k (Mγ kz b γ + Mq d γ' + Mc c) of the founding layer). Not covered and taken from BNBC 2020 (named so in the report): torsion of SP 63 8.1.36-8.1.45, φb of SP 16 Appendix Ж (the parent method's χLT), the dynamic factor ξ of flexible buildings, the SP 14 Section 6 detailing rules (SAEngine's intermediate level), connections, masonry, timber, the bar schedule and every table not in covers. Every value names its clause; VERIFY.md lists them, with the uncertain ones (most: no code text was available), for checking against the printed codes.
